presentation.label: MIDI GENERATOR
presentation.summary: Looping shift registers write the notes of the Octatrack's MIDI tracks.
presentation.overview: Live looping shift registers on MIDI tracks. Choose TURING in MIDI NOTE SETUP, then use AMP for MODE, LOCK, LEN, SCAL and DENS. FUNC+AMP opens SCALE and ROOT. Push encoder A to WRITE the phrase into ordinary trigs.
highlights: MODE and the 64-bit phrase register stay per pattern and MIDI track.
LOCK, LEN, SCAL and DENS are shared by patterns using the same Part.
Own major/minor quantizer with twelve roots; SRC and the LFO stay stock.
Push encoder A to WRITE; the stock arpeggiator is replaced.
usage: Select a MIDI track. Open FUNC+SRC, choose TURING with DOWN and YES, then close NOTE SETUP.
Press AMP and turn MODE on. B LOCK, C LEN, D SCAL and E DENS shape the phrase.
FUNC+AMP opens SCALE (A) and ROOT (B); release FUNC to edit; NO returns to the main page.
Push A to WRITE. MODE OFF plays the written trigs; choose OFF in NOTE SETUP to leave the generator.

controls.name: MODE
controls.doc: AMP A: per-pattern Turing playback switch; the Part must also choose TURING.

controls.name: LOCK
controls.doc: AMP B: per-Part flip chance, one value per encoder tick.

controls.name: LEN
controls.doc: AMP C: per-Part loop length, 2 to 64.

controls.name: SCAL
controls.doc: AMP D: per-Part pitch range around stock NOTE, 0 to 48 semitones.

controls.name: DENS
controls.doc: AMP E: per-Part note density, 0 silent to 127 every step.

controls.name: SCALE
controls.doc: FUNC+AMP A: per-Part quantizer, after TRAN; an out-of-key note snaps one semitone down. Release FUNC before editing.

controls.name: ROOT
controls.doc: FUNC+AMP B: absolute per-Part root of the scale. Release FUNC before editing.

limitations: Minimum supported Modwerk base: 0.7.9, on stock OS 1.40C. Hardware untested; private draft under #1697.
MODE/register anchors use DRAM plus saved-project comments. Unsaved changes are lost on power-cycle or reinstall.
LOCK/LEN/SCAL/DENS/SCALE/ROOT are per Part; patterns sharing a Part share those settings.
Release FUNC after FUNC+AMP before editing SCALE or ROOT. The former FUNC+LOCK snap shortcut is retired.
Replaces the arpeggiator. Existing Turing projects using arp MODE change; old FIRST is ignored.
Stock firmware can read saved projects, but the arp step mask and note offsets hold generator data.
SCALE remains OFF/MAJ/MIN with twelve roots, using the shared scale SDK and the historical down-one/drop rule.

storage.label: Runtime memory
storage.conditions: 43,708 initialized image bytes plus 4,536 bytes BSS in the reproducible USB package; within the 128 KiB image and 288 KiB total per-module caps. Loader overhead and whole-set headroom are separate.

processing.label: CPU / DSP load
processing.conditions: No measurements exist yet. Add exact conditions and source evidence when available.

tests.summary: Hardware untested / #1697 draft. Software observations on Modwerk base 0.7.9 and the exact USB package are recorded in TESTING.md. No physical USB or reboot qualification.
